question: A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item 52% above its cost price. What percentage of discount on the marked price should be allowed to gain 14%?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (C.P) = ₹100 (Assume)

Marked Price (M.P) = ₹100 + 52% of ₹100 = ₹152

Profit = 14%

**Formula used:**

Sell Price (S.P) = C.P + Profit% of C.P

Discount% = (M.P - S.P)/(M.P) × 100

**Calculation:**

S.P = ₹100 + 14% of ₹100

⇒ S.P = ₹100 + ₹14

⇒ S.P = ₹114

Discount = M.P - S.P

⇒ Discount = ₹152 - ₹114

⇒ Discount = ₹38

Discount% = (Discount)/(M.P) × 100

⇒ Discount% = (38)/(152) × 100

⇒ Discount% = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
